name: Bronte Ramsay
bio:
Bronte Ramsay's motorsport journey began in the dusty workshops of rural New South Wales, fueled by a childhood spent tinkering with engines alongside her father, a seasoned mechanic. After earning her engineering degree from the University of Sydney, she quickly rose through the ranks, working with various Australian racing teams before making the leap to Europe. Her sharp analytical mind and ability to translate complex data into actionable strategies earned her a reputation as a rising star.

Bronte is known for her meticulous attention to detail and her collaborative approach to problem-solving. She believes in fostering a culture of open communication and continuous improvement within her team, always encouraging her engineers to push the boundaries of innovation while remaining grounded in practical application. Her calm demeanor, even under intense pressure, makes her a highly respected and effective leader. What sets Bronte apart is her innate ability to identify subtle performance gains often overlooked by others, a skill honed by years of experience and a deep understanding of vehicle dynamics. Now at Eurofarma RC, Bronte hopes to bring the team to consistent podium finishes.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, slightly wavy, often pulled back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Bronte has a focused gaze and a no-nonsense demeanor, reflecting her dedication to her work.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on starting every race day with a strong cup of Australian coffee.
